method: Evaluated unsimplified source triangles; exact BVH triangle overlap, bounded bidirectional penetration samples confirmed by three oriented ray winding counts (not exhaustive volume certification); axial contact ray casts and radial guide rays.
limitations: Switch actuator is a compliant nominal placeholder; actuator entering the switch body is expected and not a solid-material certification.
Spring stiffness, switch rated travel and friction cannot be measured from mesh geometry.
